review_description: Jamie & the team were fantastic, he had a part fail twice on him but persisted to ensure it worked 100%

The sales / quoting process was straightforward and honest.Customer service was excellent right from the start, with great communications from quote to finish.Jamie set everything up and explained the system clearly.His team were also excellent.Always arrived on time, and they were very neat.Highly recommend 2EZ

Jamie contacted me very quickly after I requested quotes through SolarQuotes.  He was friendly, genuine and honest when he came to our house and was efficient is getting the quotes to us.  He answered any questions we had very promptly.  All the way through, we never felt like we were being sold something we didn't need.  The installation was carried out so efficiently by Jamie and his employee.  They arrived on time and worked non-stop, making sure everything was tidied up afterwards.  Jamie went through everything we needed to know about the app and grid connection once the installation was complete.  We highly recommend 2EZ Solar to anyone in Cairns looking for a local company to install their solar.

It wasn’t hard to make the decision to go with 2EZ electrical. Locally run company, not pushy to get you to buy a system, great price, knows the equipment inside out. Great price and great after install service.Highly recommended!!
